Resolves #21104

Adds an instance-owned lazy predecessor and successor index (`#predecessors` / `#successors`) to `Neo.gantt.DependencyStore`, rebuilding in one pass over `getAt(i)` on first read after construction or invalidation while returning fresh arrays in current store order and preserving string/numeric task ID matching and nullish `[]` handling. Invalidation covers `splice` mutations (`countMutations`/`count`), filter resets (`_items`), silent clears (`clearSilent`), reordering (`sortArray`, `move`, `reverse`), record field writes and rollbacks across shared stores (`RecordFactory#getWriteEpoch`), raw-row batch edits (`writeRows`), and `destroy()`.

Evidence: L1 (Playwright unit suite on Node/V8 store runtime) → L1 required (AC-1..AC-3 DependencyStore endpoint lookup & mutation invariants).

Micro-review eligible: mechanical — single-store private endpoint index plus domain-agnostic `RecordFactory#getWriteEpoch` invalidation and unit regressions preserving exact public lookup signatures and scan semantics.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/gantt/Stores.spec.mjs` (`repeated predecessor and successor lookups over a 2,048-edge chain index the store in a single pass` — 64 reads across task IDs 1..32 plus repeat pass and unrelated `TaskStore` mutation hit `getAt` `2,048` times vs `131,072` previously, returning exact matching record instances) |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/gantt/Stores.spec.mjs` (`endpoint lookups match full scans across mutations, silent updates, retargeting, sorting, filtering and caller array writes` & `endpoint lookups stay coherent on reverse, setSilent, prepared adoption/rollback and shared stores` — compares `getPredecessors`/`getSuccessors` against full-scan oracles across adds, removals, retargeting, `updateRows` including raw Turbo Mode rows, `splice(..., true)`, `startUpdate(true)`/`endUpdate(true)`, `clearSilent()`, `data` replacement, sorting, `move()`, `reverse()`, `setSilent()`, `RecordFactory.applyPreparedFields` first-listener/warm-rollback/cold-rollback, `sourceId` linked stores, filtered `allItems`, and caller array mutation) |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/gantt/` passes alongside `test/playwright/unit/data/` (`593 passed`) preserving `DependencyStore`, `DependencyCreation`, `Cascade`, `DependencyLayer`, `DependencyLayerHydration`, and `Container` specs alongside `test/playwright/unit/gantt/Stores.spec.mjs` |

## Deltas from ticket

Added domain-agnostic `RecordFactory#getWriteEpoch` tracking in `src/data/RecordFactory.mjs` alongside `src/gantt/DependencyStore.mjs` so `setSilent`, prepared field adoption/rollback, and shared-record stores (`sourceId`, filtered `allItems`) invalidate caches coherently without subscribing per-record.

All coverage runs in CI.

# PR Review Summary

**Status:** Request Changes

### 🪜 Strategic-Fit Decision

- **Decision**: Request Changes
- **Peer-Review Opening:** Julia, the lazy index removes the repeated scan on unchanged data. I found three ways a caller can get a different answer from the current store contents.

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

- **Inputs Read Before Patch:** #21104 and the two public endpoint methods at `79f1de332a`.
- **Expected Solution Shape:** Pay once for repeated reads, preserving edge identity, order and the answer visible at each point in a supported write.
- **Patch Verdict:** The one-pass construction works. The cache can outlive the order or endpoint values it indexes.
- **Premise Coherence:** A caller that already holds an edge must see its current endpoints reflected in both lookup methods.

### 🕸️ Context & Graph Linking

- **PR / Target Issue:** #21106 / #21104
- **Head under review:** `ea70fbb6c4d394d6b1ef69c6ab0a20568481e067`
- **Origin Session ID:** 715cc9e5-d5e9-4715-9621-870fd2f3becd

### 🔬 Depth Floor

I compared the exact parent and PR using real Engine stores. The parent matched a fresh scan in each case.

| Operation | Result on this head |
|---|---|
| Warm a two-edge bucket `[e1,e2]`, then call the public `store.reverse()` with no sorters. | The store reads `[e2,e1]`, but both endpoint lookups retain the old order. [Collection reverse](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/ea70fbb6c4d394d6b1ef69c6ab0a20568481e067/src/collection/Base.mjs#L1419-L1425) |
| Warm the index on `e: a → b`, then call `e.setSilent({toId:'c'})`. | The record reads `c`. The bucket for `b` still contains it and the bucket for `c` is empty. [Record setter](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/ea70fbb6c4d394d6b1ef69c6ab0a20568481e067/src/data/RecordFactory.mjs#L360-L366) |
| Change `toId` with `RecordFactory.applyPreparedFields`. Read the initially cold index inside `seal`, then throw to roll back. | The record restores `b`, but the cached answer still places it under `c`. With a warm index the converse happens inside the seal. In a successful two-record batch, a synchronous listener for the **first** record can also see the second record’s new endpoint field while its lookup still returns the old bucket. [Adoption and rollback](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/ea70fbb6c4d394d6b1ef69c6ab0a20568481e067/src/data/RecordFactory.mjs#L486-L520) |
| Warm a linked `DependencyStore({sourceId: owner.id})`, then retarget an edge via ordinary `record.set` on the owner. | The linked store holds the same updated record but keeps its old buckets, during the owner’s callback and after the setter returns. A filtered store’s `allItems` also reproduced it. [Shared records](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/ea70fbb6c4d394d6b1ef69c6ab0a20568481e067/src/collection/Base.mjs#L278-L299) |

### 🧠 Graph Ingestion Notes

`#ensureEndpointIndex` uses array identity, count and membership-mutation count. In-place reversal and shared-record field writes can leave all three unchanged. The per-store `onRecordChange` hook runs after a successful seal and only for stores that receive that notification. [Index validity check](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/ea70fbb6c4d394d6b1ef69c6ab0a20568481e067/src/gantt/DependencyStore.mjs#L130-L138)
